bullets.text: Forgettable Characters Drag Down JRPG - **Octopath Traveler 0** fails to innovate, featuring a dull silent protagonist.
OpenAI's Year-End Recap - New feature 'Your Year with ChatGPT' offers personalized highlights for users in select countries.
Waymo's Robotaxis Stuck - Software update aims to improve navigation during power outages after recent congestion issues.
Nvidia's Major Move - **Nvidia** licenses **Groq**'s AI chip technology, hiring key personnel to strengthen its market position.
Apple's Reminders Upgrade - New time zone support in **iOS 26** enhances usability for travelers during busy holiday seasons.
Meta's WhatsApp Policy Under Fire - Italy orders **Meta** to suspend its ban on rival AI chatbots in the app.
Generative AI in Gaming - 2025 sees a surge in generative AI use, sparking debate among developers and gamers alike.
Amazon's Prime Settlement - **Amazon** pays $1.5 billion to customers misled into Prime subscriptions, following FTC scrutiny.
